b092: If the 5-HTP gives you nausea or stomach discomfort, stop the trial. Same with loose stools or a headache. Stop immediately if you get agitation together with sweating, diarrhea, tremor or clonus, and fever, confusion, a fast heart rate or unstable blood pressure, since that pattern can be serotonin toxicity, which can become dangerous. Feeling anxious, irritable or agitated, sweating, tremor, or a too-bright, kind of hypomanic feeling are milder stop signs, and so are insomnia and dreams that get vivid or intense.
